text:
mira-s: Quick heads-up 1: Candidate (Samir Khan) messaged: family emergency, might arrive late. His onsite loop is 09:00-12:30 with onsite system design at 11:00. Can we prepare a remote fallback for the morning?

devon-p: I can move my 10:00 slot to 12:00 if needed. If 11:00 design must be onsite, we should hold that and run the earlier ones remote.

jonah: I prefer in-person for the design interview but can do remote if Samir prefers.

calendar-bot: Backup Meet created: https://meet.google.com/samir-backup. Added link to 09:00 and 10:00 invites. Reserved Quiet Room A 10:30-13:00 for candidate prep.

frontdesk-bot: Pre-registration for "Samir Khan" complete. Parking permit emailed. Badge will be at reception if he arrives.

mira-s: People Ops will cover rideshare up to $90 if he misses his connection. I'll DM candidate and send the panel note.

recruiter-bot: Candidate message queued (posted here):

"Hi Samir 1: Sorry to hear. We can run the morning interviews remotely using this Meet: https://meet.google.com/samir-backup. We'll keep the 11:00 design slot open for onsite if you can make it; Quiet Room A will be available for you to set up. If you need a rideshare, we can cover up to $90 (send receipts to hr@redwood.ai). Please confirm preference"

mira-s: Sent at 07:25 1: candidate replied: "Thanks, I'll join remote for the morning and try to make the 11:00 onsite."

devon-p: :thumbsup: I'm set to pivot.

jonah: OK, I'll have my slides ready for remote.

mira-s: Closing loop 1: candidate joined remote at 09:00, arrived onsite at 10:50 and attended the 11:00 design in person. Rideshare not needed. :white_check_mark:
